title: Probabilistic filters and sketches
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for cache-line blocked Bloom filters, deletable Cuckoo filters, static Xor filters, multi-probe LSH and streaming sketches.
boundaries: BlockedBloomFilter, CuckooFilter and StaticXorFingerprintFilter act strictly as one-sided membership shields: negative checks guarantee absence for static/unevicted keys, while positive checks still require exact downstream verification when collisions matter.
CuckooFilter deletions apply only to keys previously inserted into the filter; deleting uninserted keys can create false negatives.
All bit-widths, hash counts, bucket capacities, probe radii and sketch dimensions resolve from externalized configuration grid specs and pass ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for cache-line blocked Bloom filters, deletable Cuckoo filters, static Xor filters, multi-probe LSH and streaming sketches

value.lets_workers: Shield expensive storage and network reads with cache-line BlockedBloomFilter bitsets, prune gone 404 spider targets in O(1) with CuckooFilter, pack static edge tables into ~9-10 bits per key with StaticXorFingerprintFilter, recover near-duplicate recall across 128-bit SimHash bands with MultiProbeSimHashLshExpander, detect holdout contamination with MinHashLshDecontaminator and summarize Zipfian streams with ConservativeCountMinHeavyKeeperHll.

flow.when: Construct grid-governed BlockedBloomFilter, CuckooFilter or StaticXorFingerprintFilter structures for read shielding, O(1) target deletion or static graph membership.
Expand 128-bit SimHash bands with 1-bit and budgeted 2-bit multi-probe neighbors and screen candidate corpora against evaluation holdouts via banded MinHash LSH.
Independently verify ConservativeCountMinHeavyKeeperHll summaries, SimHash recall curves, filter false-negative guarantees and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate conformance.

value.worked_example: Synthetic filter, multi-probe LSH, holdout decontamination and streaming sketch bundle recomputed in test_probabilistic_sketches.py: verifies 0% false negatives on unioned BlockedBloomFilter shards, O(1) 404 CuckooFilter deletion with 56-char base64 round-trip, 9.936 bits/key StaticXorFingerprintFilter over 1,000 static edges, 136-key 1-bit SimHash multi-probe recall recovery (0.18 -> 0.788 at Hamming distance 24 and 100% Pigeonhole recovery), holdout contamination detection and HeavyKeeper/HLL stream summarization.

nouns.title: Guardrail: membership filters never delete uninserted keys and require Cuckoo strategy when deletions are enabled
nouns.category_reason: Prevents silent false negatives from deleting absent fingerprints or using append-only Bloom/Xor filters on mutable sets.

value.rule: Use BlockedBloomFilter or StaticXorFingerprintFilter only for append-only or immutable sets, require CuckooFilter whenever O(1) deletion of gone 404 items is enabled and delete only previously inserted targets.
value.how_it_is_checked: Grid constraint deletes-require-cuckoo rejects non-Cuckoo delete regimes, and unit tests verify 0% false negatives across remaining live keys after 404 pruning.

Implements CuckooFilter with partial-key cuckoo hashing, O(1) delete and compact base64 serialization plus StaticXorFingerprintFilter with 3-wise hypergraph peeling.
Implements MultiProbeSimHashLshExpander (136 0/1-bit + budgeted 2-bit probe keys), MinHashLshDecontaminator and ConservativeCountMinHeavyKeeperHll verified by ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.
does_not: Perform network I/O, mutate live services or inline hardcoded numeric thresholds.
